root_cause: Candidate writer received response and alignment; race writer received shortened candidate prose and omitted the structured legislative channel.
caveat: This audit screens legislative response/alignment consistency, not every factual claim or source truth. Initial model flags were reviewed; differences in dates, policy interpretation and unprovided endorsement context were not counted as vote contradictions.
review_note: A deterministic check of exclusive contrary-vote claims found the Ro Khanna error even though the model follow-up did not. Automated audits are screening aids, not a proof that other prose is error-free.
